purpose: Correct only the no-return quality-state materialization so it exactly matches the repository-standard attach_quality_asof semantics before any forward return is read.

superseded_no_return_audit.reason: Its custom no-price helper selected one latest fundamental event row and treated a missing field on that event as ineligible instead of reproducing the repository-standard per-field forward-fill across already-effective disclosures.

superseded_diagnostic_preregistration.reason: It is bound to the superseded no-return audit and therefore may not be consumed.

root_cause.repository_standard: attach_quality_asof places every already-effective disclosure on an instrument timeline and forward-fills each quality column separately; a later disclosure with one missing field does not erase an earlier already-known value for that field.
root_cause.incorrect_helper: quality_listing_eligible_keys selected the latest effective event row as an indivisible record and rejected the row when any required field on that event was missing.
root_cause.example: SZ002971 was quality-eligible from 2020-02-17 under the standard timeline because its earlier disclosed Q2 revenue_yoy and profit_yoy remained known even though the later Q3 row omitted those fields.

only_authorized_repair.implementation: After the identical effective-date sort and same-effective-date last-record selection, forward-fill roe, net_profit, revenue_yoy, and profit_yoy separately within each instrument before mapping the latest effective state to holding dates.

required_next_steps: preserve the superseded audit and diagnostic preregistration
add an offline regression that reproduces per-field quality forward-fill
rerun the exact no-return coverage capacity and four-factor uniqueness audit with the corrected helper
freeze a new diagnostic preregistration bound to the corrected audit before any forward return construction
